name: Camino Húngaro, Budapest–Lébény–Rajka-Wolfsthal
description_md:
The Camino Húngaro, Budapest-Lébény-Rajka-Wolfsthal is a waymarked hiking route located in Austria. It belongs to an international waymarked hiking network and covers a distance of 26.7 km.

The trail includes 231 m of ascent and 213 m of descent. Its difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. The route is signposted as StJ and takes about 7.3 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
